column1: # comment: "GMEOW term to Wikidata Q-item alignments (concept-scheme layer; QIDs validated)."

column7: comment
Wikidata 'agent' is a very abstract philosophical concept; GMEOW Agent is the actor in provenance and trust assertions. Directional lossy projection.
Wikidata 'social group' is broader than GMEOW Group (which includes non-social collectives). Directional lossy projection.
Wikidata 'mailbox' is primarily physical; GMEOW Mailbox covers both physical and electronic. Directional lossy projection.
Wikidata 'media file' is broader than GMEOW MediaObject (which includes non-file media); directional lossy projection
Wikidata 'graduation ceremony' is narrower than GMEOW eventTypeGraduation (which covers any educational completion); directional lossy projection
Wikidata P424 is the Wikimedia language code; GMEOW languageCode uses BCP-47. Related but not identical.
lang:english is the English natural language; wd:Q1860 (English) is the same language. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
lang:featCase is the Case feature key; wd:Q128234 (case) is the linguistic category — categorization of nouns and modifiers by function. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.
lang:featNumber is the Number feature key; wd:Q104083 (grammatical number) is the linguistic category. A concept-scoped match to the feature-inventory key, so skos:closeMatch.
lang:featTense is the Tense feature key; wd:Q177691 (tense) is the linguistic category locating a situation in time. A concept-scoped match, so skos:closeMatch.
lang:latinScript is the Latin script; wd:Q8229 (Latin script) is the same character repertoire. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
lang:noun is the noun part of speech; wd:Q1084 (noun) is the same category. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
lang:verb is the verb part of speech; wd:Q24905 (verb) is the same category. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:complexNumbers is the system ℂ; wd:Q11567 (complex number) names the number-type concept. closeMatch: the system individual and the number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.

math:eulerMascheroni is the exact constant γ; wd:Q273023 (Euler–Mascheroni constant) is the same constant — the limiting difference between the harmonic series and the natural logarithm. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:eulerNumber is the exact constant e; wd:Q82435 (Euler's number) is the same constant — the base of the natural logarithm. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.
math:integers is the system ℤ; wd:Q12503 (integer) names the number-type concept. closeMatch: the system individual and the number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.

math:naturalNumbers is the system ℕ; wd:Q21199 (natural number) names the number-type concept. closeMatch, not identity: the system individual and the (deliberately ambiguous — non-negative or positive) number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.
math:pi is the exact constant π; wd:Q167 (pi) is the same constant — the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter. Identity, so skos:exactMatch.

math:rationalNumbers is the system ℚ; wd:Q1244890 (rational number) names the number-type concept. closeMatch: the system individual and the number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.

math:realNumbers is the system ℝ; wd:Q12916 (real number) names the number-type concept. closeMatch: the system individual and the number-type concept are close counterparts, not invertibly the same object.
